name: Slendrina Free
long_description: Slendrina is a new horror game. Try to find 6 objects without being caught by Slendrina if you see her turn around as soon possible. There are three maps (1.0): the House, the Yard and the Hotel. Its a bit like Slender Man but Slendrina is more evil. Be careful. Removed the "Full Version" flag. I will update the version over time.
requirements: Requires a jailbroken PS Vita/PSTV and installation of the VPK via VitaShell (or compatible package installer).
